title: Show favorited inspector properties in their original spot

target.summary: `_apply_property_editor_flags()` unconditionally calls `p_ep->set_deletable(deletable_properties)`, overriding the deletable status previously set for metadata properties. As a result, node and object metadata properties cannot be deleted in the inspector.
notes: faulty statement unconditionally overriding deletable flag
